effect.minecraft.speed.desc: Increases movement speed. In this game, it commonly appears on role skills, splash potions, and short buffs.
effect.minecraft.slowness.desc: Decreases movement speed. In this game, each level is roughly -20%; Slowness VI completely locks you in place.
effect.minecraft.haste.desc: Increases mining and attack speed. Rarely used as a core kill method in this game.
effect.minecraft.mining_fatigue.desc: Greatly decreases mining and attack speed.
effect.minecraft.strength.desc: Increases melee damage. Most kills in this game rely on dedicated weapons, so this usually does not change one-hit rules.
effect.minecraft.instant_health.desc: Instantly restores health. Health does not regenerate vanilla-style in most game modes, so this has limited use.
effect.minecraft.jump_boost.desc: Increases jump height. Some shop splash potions apply this.
effect.minecraft.nausea.desc: Distorts and wobbles the screen, interfering with aiming and observation.
effect.minecraft.regeneration.desc: Continuously restores health. Most game modes do not heal vanilla-style.
effect.minecraft.resistance.desc: Reduces damage taken. Some roles or modes use it for brief damage reduction.
effect.minecraft.fire_resistance.desc: Grants immunity to fire and lava damage.
effect.minecraft.invisibility.desc: Invisible. In this game, you may still be seen by true-skin, see-through, or certain role mechanics.
effect.minecraft.blindness.desc: Vision is heavily darkened; you can only see extremely close. Different from this mod's blind_vision and darkness.
effect.minecraft.night_vision.desc: See clearly in the dark. Partially counters darkness, but cannot remove blindness or blind vision.
effect.minecraft.hunger.desc: Accelerates hunger depletion. This game usually does not rely on vanilla hunger.
effect.minecraft.poison.desc: Vanilla poison: continuously drains health but never below 1 HP. Most Poisoner/alchemy 'poison' in this game uses a separate poison system and differs from this.
effect.minecraft.wither.desc: Continuously drains health and can be fatal.
effect.minecraft.absorption.desc: Grants extra golden hearts. This game also has a separate shield layer system.
effect.minecraft.glowing.desc: Outline glows and is visible through walls. Often used to reveal positions in this game.
effect.minecraft.luck.desc: Vanilla luck, affects loot quality. This game's draws and shop usually do not read this effect.
effect.minecraft.unluck.desc: Vanilla bad luck, affects loot quality. This game usually does not read this effect.
effect.minecraft.slow_falling.desc: Slows falling, reducing or avoiding fall damage.
effect.minecraft.conduit_power.desc: Conduit Power: underwater vision, mining, and breathing.
effect.minecraft.bad_omen.desc: Entering a village may trigger a raid. Train maps usually do not have this gameplay.
effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.des: Villager trading discount after winning a raid. Usually not used in this game.
effect.minecraft.darkness.desc: Periodically darkens vision; you can still see your surroundings. Applied by lights-out or certain roles in this game. Different from blindness.
effect.minecraft.trial_omen.desc: Trial Omen. Generally not used in this game.
effect.minecraft.raid_omen.desc: Raid Omen. Generally not used in this game.
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.desc: On death, creates a wind burst. Limited impact on train rounds.
effect.minecraft.infested.desc: On taking damage, has a chance to spawn silverfish.
effect.noellesroles.shop_banned.desc: Prevents opening or using the shop to purchase.
effect.noellesroles.cca_freezed.desc: Freezes the role/CCA tick logic; skill timers and some passives are paused.
effect.noellesroles.skill_freezed.desc: Freezes role ticks and prevents skill use simultaneously. Often stacked by mechanics such as meetings.
effect.noellesroles.skill_baned.desc: Prevents skill use, but does not necessarily freeze cooldown ticks.
effect.noellesroles.true_skin.desc: Forces showing your true appearance; no longer goes through skin replacement or disguise logic.
effect.noellesroles.true_skin_observer.d: Eagle Eye: other players you see all display their true skins, ignoring skin replacement.
effect.noellesroles.jump_decrease.desc: Reduces jump strength. Higher level means shorter jumps.
effect.noellesroles.inventory_baned.desc: Cannot open the inventory or manipulate items.
effect.noellesroles.eat_meat_food.desc: Restricts eating logic, used together with meat-related roles and mechanics.
effect.noellesroles.next_skill_baned.des: Your next skill is sealed. Spellbreaker potions apply this effect to the target.
effect.noellesroles.tarot_assembly.desc: Tarot Assembly mark. Can alter death judgment within specific coordinate zones.
effect.noellesroles.black_monitor.desc: Black screen: the client view is obscured, often appearing alongside control or immobilization effects.
effect.noellesroles.ghost_state.desc: Enters ghost state, used for out-of-body or ghost-related roles.
effect.noellesroles.tripwire_slow.desc: Tripwire snare: movement speed multiplied by 0.1 (about -90%), different from Slowness VI's full lockdown.
effect.noellesroles.move_baned.desc: Cannot move. Often used together with turn/key seals for immobilization.
effect.noellesroles.used_baned.desc: Cannot use items or most key interactions.
effect.noellesroles.move_upside_down.des: Movement forward/backward and left/right directions are inverted.
effect.noellesroles.upside_down.desc: All other entities you see are upside down.
effect.noellesroles.puppet_wander.desc: Puppet Wander: your body automatically walks slowly in random directions, usually paired with movement/turn seals, and includes cliff detection to avoid walking into the void.
effect.noellesroles.time_stop.desc: Time stop: freezes the world and most actions; the screen gets a grayscale filter, along with side effects such as control lockdown and muting.
effect.noellesroles.no_collide.desc: No collision: can pass through players or blocks, depending on how it is applied. Often used for passing through doors, extraction, or special displacement.
effect.noellesroles.phantom_spirit_revea: Phantom Spirit Sight: purely a client-side see-through marker, usually with no particles or icons.
effect.noellesroles.swim_pose.desc: Tripped: forced into a swimming/crawling pose, temporarily cannot stand or walk normally.
effect.noellesroles.tomato_sauce.desc: Tomato sauce screen: the client view is covered in tomato sauce, interfering with observation.
effect.noellesroles.tomato_form.desc: Tomato form: the client switches third-person and dropped item models accordingly (Tomato Head transformation).
effect.noellesroles.safe_time.desc: Safe Time: in a protected state, usually cannot be killed by conventional means, and often comes with no-collision. Applied by meetings and some skills.
effect.noellesroles.ghost_curse.desc: Ghost Bind: Ma Chen Xu's attack curse. The afflicted is invisible, cannot move, cannot use items, and has red particles; Safe Time is maintained during this.
effect.noellesroles.otherworld_aura.desc: Backworld Erosion: marks good players under the backworld's influence, driving client filters and scene changes.
effect.noellesroles.nostalgist_backworld: Nostalgist backworld mark: maintains the grayscale filter and hides held items. Bans on speaking or using items are applied together via chat ban, voice silence, key seals, and so on.
effect.noellesroles.backworld_outline.de: Backworld same-realm outline: only when you are also in the backworld can you see glowing outlines of other players who also hold this effect.
effect.noellesroles.peer_xray.desc: Peer see-through: players with this effect and the same potion level see through each other; different levels make them mutually invisible.
effect.noellesroles.instinct_conceal.des: Instinct Conceal: while active, you cannot be seen by anyone's Killer instinct see-through — others see no instinct outline around you. The outline returns when the effect ends; this effect does not work on corpses (corpses are still seen through).
effect.noellesroles.wraith_dimension.des: Wraith Dimension: marks that the player is currently in the Wraith's pain dimension.
effect.noellesroles.wraith_manifest.desc: Wraith Manifest: state mark during the Wraith's manifestation.
effect.noellesroles.footstep_vanish.desc: Vanishing footsteps: others cannot hear your footsteps, and sprint particles are not shown.
effect.noellesroles.mood_drain_reduction: Slows natural Sanity/mood depletion. Higher level means more reduction (about -30% per level, stacking to immunity).
Mood no longer naturally drops from tasks.
effect.noellesroles.mood_regeneration.de: Continuously and slowly restores mood. Higher level means faster regen.
effect.noellesroles.invincible.desc: Invincible: usually immune to death. Special roles such as Loose End may still break it.
effect.noellesroles.infinite_stamina.des: Sprinting costs no stamina. If you also have No Stamina, you still cannot sprint infinitely.
effect.noellesroles.stamina_boost.desc: Increases stamina cap. About +35% per level.
effect.noellesroles.stamina_recovery.des: Increases stamina recovery speed when not sprinting. About +75% per level.
effect.noellesroles.low_san_shader_resis: Reduces post-processing visual interference at low Sanity. Higher level means stronger resistance.
effect.noellesroles.fairyland_filter.des: Fairyland Filter: pure visual immersive post-processing, no additional gameplay side effects.
effect.noellesroles.afterlife_filter.des: Afterlife Filter: pure visual immersive post-processing.
effect.noellesroles.dreamcore_filter.des: Dreamcore Filter: pure visual immersive post-processing.
effect.noellesroles.backrooms_filter.des: Backrooms Filter: VHS tape-style backrooms visuals, purely visual, no gameplay side effects.
effect.noellesroles.player_isolation.des: Cannot see or hear other players.
effect.noellesroles.heavy_metal_voice.de: Lowers voice chat pitch. Higher level means deeper.
effect.noellesroles.voice_range_boost.de: Expands voice propagation range. Higher level means farther.
effect.noellesroles.voice_echo.desc: Voice has an echo. The level affects the number of echoes.
effect.noellesroles.voice_beep.desc: Replaces speech with beeping that follows your intonation; content is unclear but emotion is perceptible.
effect.noellesroles.voice_robot.desc: Robotic electronic voice; content is still roughly understandable.
effect.noellesroles.voice_helmet.desc: Muffled voice, as if speaking through a helmet or from far away.
effect.noellesroles.voice_underwater.des: Low-pass filter with reduced volume, simulating speaking underwater.
effect.noellesroles.voice_synth.desc: Synthesized vocals / auto-tune, like an electronic diva or a singing robot.
effect.noellesroles.voice_distortion.des: Distorted voice, like a broken radio or electric guitar distortion.
effect.noellesroles.voice_chorus.desc: Chorus voice, like multiple copies of yourself speaking at once.
effect.noellesroles.voice_tremolo.desc: Tremolo: volume wavers on and off.
effect.noellesroles.voice_stutter.desc: Stutter: repeats short audio clips, like a skipping record.
effect.noellesroles.voice_reverse.desc: Reversed voice, like playing a tape backward.
effect.noellesroles.skin_masked.desc: Skin Masked: the client replaces or obscures your appearance.
effect.noellesroles.voice_helium.desc: Helium voice: higher-pitched voice. Higher level means squeakier.
effect.noellesroles.chat_ban.desc: The text chat you send is not seen by anyone.
effect.noellesroles.monokuma_frenzy.desc: Monokuma Frenzy / Rampage: everyone or the holder enters a Rampage-related state (slowness, no inventory, ink wash filter, etc., depending on implementation).
effect.noellesroles.disguise.desc: Disguise: while active, the client replaces the player's skin with a reserved disguise skin. Other players can also see it.
effect.noellesroles.mirror_reunion.desc: Broken Mirror Reunion: first the view shakes, then surrounding blocks collapse from outside in, then rise back up. Client-side only.
effect.noellesroles.time_rewind_mark.des: Time Rewind Mark: state indicator during rewind.
effect.noellesroles.time_rewind_daze.des: Spacetime Daze: briefly applied to everyone when the Time Delayer rewinds, triggering the client's spacetime filter.
effect.noellesroles.time_stop_filter.des: Time Stop Filter: only the same grayscale visuals as time stop; does not freeze the world, does not lock control, does not mute.
effect.noellesroles.eerie_domain.desc: Eerie Domain: inside Ghost Eye Yang Jian's eerie domain, Killer instinct see-through cannot be activated.
effect.noellesroles.no_stamina.desc: No stamina; cannot sprint off stamina; overrides infinite stamina.
effect.noellesroles.domain_mark.desc: Domain mark. Level 0 = Fool's meeting, Level 1 = Warlock's arena, Level 2 = Adventurer's travelogue. While held, cannot be pulled into another domain.
effect.noellesroles.vision_fog.desc: Vision is shrouded in thick fog. Level 1 is only about 2 blocks; each level adds about 3 blocks.
effect.noellesroles.two_dimensional_came: 2D/2.5D view. Level determines orientation: 0-3 is side/bird's-eye, 4 is top-down, 5-8 is pure flat side view. Shows an arrow pointing to the task point.
2D camera distance. Higher level means farther camera.
effect.noellesroles.pointer.desc: Shows a mouse pointer and makes the player face the block or entity hit by the pointer ray.
effect.noellesroles.hakoniwa_vision.desc: Hakoniwa Vision: automatically builds the current room and cuts away occluding faces. Hides roofs in bird's-eye view, cuts walls facing the camera in side view. Renders fully again once you step onto the roof.
effect.noellesroles.tremble.desc: Trembling hands: crosshair/view slowly drifts randomly. Players seen during Dream's Rampage get this effect.
effect.noellesroles.suika_small.desc: Suika Shrunk: state related to shrinking body size.
effect.noellesroles.illiterate.desc: Illiterate: about 20% of client text turns to garbled characters; layout is still calculated based on the original text. Excludes a few screens such as role descriptions.
effect.noellesroles.blind_vision.desc: Blind Vision: the world is black and white. Only places where sound has traveled appear; louder sound means farther and clearer range.
effect.noellesroles.deafness.desc: Deaf: cannot hear game sounds, music, ambient noise, or receive voice.
effect.noellesroles.muffled_hearing.desc: Muffled Hearing: some volume remains, but game audio and voice are low-passed, hard to understand.
effect.noellesroles.keen_hearing.desc: Deadened Hearing: surrounding sounds become extremely faint, only barely audible.
effect.noellesroles.limp.desc: Limp: walks with a limp, severity increases with level, and affects leg movement in first/third person.
effect.noellesroles.myopia.desc: Nearsighted: distant objects are blurry, near is relatively clear. Higher level means worse distance vision.
effect.noellesroles.hand_tremor.desc: Hand Tremor: crosshair shakes slightly when holding a blade or gun, strongest right after drawing; level increases the amplitude.
effect.noellesroles.mental_deafness.desc: Mental Deafness: mood is always treated as full and no longer naturally drops.
effect.noellesroles.cognitive_bias.desc: Human Cognitive Bias: other players' skins are randomly replaced, and names are blurred as if at low mood.
effect.noellesroles.loss_of_appetite.des: Loss of Appetite: cannot eat food or drink.
effect.noellesroles.missing_lungs.desc: Missing Lungs: suffocates to death after a while. Default level 1 is about 115 seconds, minus 5 seconds per level.
effect.noellesroles.aphrenia.desc: Aphrenia: intermittently loses self, taken over by dummy wander. Default interval 30-45 seconds, lasting 10-15 seconds.
effect.noellesroles.intellect_drop.desc: Intellect Drop: intermittently cannot use items.
effect.noellesroles.motor_dysfunction.de: Motor Dysfunction: has a chance to trip (swimming pose) while moving.
effect.noellesroles.coward.desc: Coward: fears when someone dies nearby; sits and shivers for the entire fear duration (at most once per 120 seconds per player).
effect.noellesroles.fear.desc: Fear: sits for the entire effect duration, while the screen and body shake slightly.
effect.noellesroles.rage.desc: Rage: after someone dies nearby, screen turns red, speed +50%, and locks onto the nearest player for 5 seconds.
effect.noellesroles.rage_surge.desc: Rage Surge: red screen, speed boost, and locks onto the nearest player.
effect.noellesroles.cowardice.desc: Cowardice: after someone dies nearby, uncontrollably runs away along a path once.
effect.noellesroles.third_person.desc: Third Person: camera fixed to back third-person view.
effect.noellesroles.glitch.desc: Glitch: surrounding blocks render in random colors.
effect.stupid_express.arsonist_burning.d: Burning: after the Arsonist ignites a target, they burn continuously and die when the burn ends.
